WCF Digital

WCF Digital is a national-scale claims and compensation management system for insured workers

A workflow foundation for compensation cases where policy, status, ownership, and external handoffs must remain traceable.

Project
WCF Digital
Context
Social Security Office Thailand
Product
Workmen’s Compensation Fund System
Year
2025-2026
Domain
  • Legal & Policy-Based
  • Claims & Compensation
Platform
  • Internal Web System

My role
  • UX/UI Design
  • System Foundation
Work area
  • Case Workflow
  • System Mapping

  • Handoff Logic

Challenge

The long-running system carried extensive legal requirements while real work was scattered across channels, leaving case status, handoffs, and ownership unclear.

Approach

I interviewed domain experts and worked with vendors, BA, backend leads, and users to map contradictions, policies, master data, and case handoffs into one buildable workflow foundation.

Outcome

The redesigned structure reduces ambiguous handoffs and off-system work, supports policy-complete processing, and makes each case easier to follow and audit.

Detail

The design went beyond new screens to make case, status, ownership, master data, and handoff logic operate as one system.
